# 462. Minimum Moves to Equal Array Elements II

## Solution 1 (time O(nlog(n)), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def minMoves2(self, nums):
        """
        :type nums: List[int]
        :rtype: int
        """
        nums.sort()
        return sum(abs(num - nums[len(nums) // 2]) for num in nums)
```
